tasks.title: Explicit effect/capability system
tasks.objective: Model file/net/device/etc effects in IR and verifier
tasks.progress: Transitive policy analysis integrated into executeGraph before any host call (AC-029), including nested/unused nodes; capability/effect gates and declaration/grant validation tested. Effect IR profile and explicit nested sequencing implemented (AC-030); forged metadata and reversed dependencies rejected; pure compiler rejects hidden unused composite effects. AST fixed-point policy inference, pure/explicit budgets, extern checks, straight-line sequence lowering and CLI explicit grant file implemented (AC-031). Interface requirements survive IR. Pure sequences export; effectful compilation is explicitly unsupported. DONE for finite effect kernel; OS broker, full control/async and IO backends remain separate work.

tasks.title: Control-flow async and state semantics
tasks.objective: Specify & implement state, cancellation, futures, events and deterministic ordering where possible
tasks.progress: Finite reactor session (AC-032): typed state atoms, transactional FIFO handlers using existing IR, replay, bounded queue, abort propagation and late-write rejection. Textual counter runs through shared runtime. Structured control IR v2/lowering/runtime and pure standalone implemented (AC-033): eager text semantics, typed mutable scopes, if/while/for, short circuit, generic/local recursion, indexing, identical step/depth guards. Typed user throw/catch/finally profile implemented (AC-034): aliases/generics, terminal cancellation/budget guards, differential standalone, transaction rollback/replay and payload-free failure traces. Option/Result/match implemented (AC-035): explicit tagged values, nested exhaustive semantic patterns, aliases/generics, independent IR validation, exact budget/permission parity, algebraic catches/event inputs and standalone CLI export. Language async/Future implemented (AC-036): typed scoped hot tasks/await, cached outcomes, supervision and program join before event commit, root abort propagation, task ancestry/shared budgets and independent async standalone. Stream implemented (AC-037): owned snapshot sources/bounded FIFO channels, typed next/send/close and for-await, actual backpressure/copied values, computed localEffects, cancellation/terminal task wakeup, actor replay/rollback and independent standalone. ResourceHandle/using implemented (AC-038): owned typed cells, lexical LIFO cleanup outside execution ticks, runtime/independent standalone parity, trusted native lifecycle bindings with preflight, exact-once release attempts, late IO/cancellation/deadline failure diagnostics and event cleanup before commit. Public error/resource IDL now implemented under EMS-016. Acceptance audit confirms stable FIFO/replay/rollback/cancellation for the documented finite reference semantics. DONE for that scope; standalone state export remains an explicit EMS-060 compiler deliverable, not claimed implemented.

acceptanceEvidence.scope: Documented finite reference profiles; M1 and global goal remain open.

tasks.title: Contract IDL + compatibility rules
tasks.objective: Formalize contract interface, versions, errors, pre/post and implementation refs
tasks.progress: Initial public interface/binding IDL implemented (AC-039): strict versioned descriptors using existing canonical type grammar, deep-frozen canonical snapshots, exact interface/implementation pins, target/signature/determinism/policy checks without callback execution, transitive hidden composite effects, conservative backward compatibility rules. Finite atomic interface adapters enforce typed input/output, executable pre/postconditions and declared user/host errors in runtime and standalone; CLI comparison/checking and independent export verified. Composite interface installation implemented (AC-040): inspectable editable graph snapshot, shared runtime/standalone pre/post/error boundaries, explicit versioned contract graph and direct IR profiles with mandatory interfaceRef, missing binding/downcast/policy bypass rejection, nested rebinding preserves both boundaries, conditions survive atomic sealing, and failed postcondition rolls back event state. Public native resource binding implemented (AC-041): strict ems-resource-interface/1, execution ownership/value type, per-phase predicates/typed errors, factory postconditions after native ownership, readonly/write checks, inherited boundary chains around one callback/release, actual file descriptor closure, cancel/late IO and actor rollback. Advanced non-primitive native ABI/error variants remain future extensions; Program dependency locking implemented (AC-042): canonical IR and full typed contract/IDL/composite closure, SHA-256 exact trusted SDK source bytes plus declared dependency DAG, private callback provenance and captured adapter identity, snapshot before async verification, runtime/export/CLI verify gates. Same-version callback/source/target drift rejects before invocation. Core intrinsic ABI remains a trusted runtime root, not binary attestation; undeclared JS imports/global behavior are not inferred or sandboxed, state callback locks/native standalone remain unsupported. Acceptance audit confirms incompatible binding/version rejection and executable boundaries for the initial reference profile; DONE for that scope. Full ABI and target backend work remain separate. 507/507 tests, 87/87 verify pass; common conformance implemented under EMS-017.
